proposed_widenings.name: ItemDestructionPolicy.zero_hp_vessel
proposed_widenings.justification: The Folding Boat is permanently destroyed when either vessel form is reduced to 0 Hit Points. This is a damage-triggered destruction of the item itself, not a charge-exhaustion event. The current ItemDestructionPolicy discriminants (none / last_charge_roll / permanent_on_empty) are all resource-triggered; none covers HP-triggered item destruction.
proposed_widenings.evidence: If either vessel is reduced to 0 Hit Points, the Folding Boat is destroyed.

notes: Core transformation mechanic (alter_item_kind × 3 in a composite) encodes cleanly — alter_item_kind is cited in types.ts for exactly this item. The three command words are modeled as three unlimited-use Magic-action activations in a CompositeMagicItemMechanics. The 'no creatures aboard' precondition on the third command word and the cargo-handling narrative are omitted as DM-agenda. The only surface gap is the item-destruction-on-0hp policy, encoded as { kind: 'none' } placeholder.
